title: Patient Registration
description: New patients must be registered in the system with demographic and insurance information.
acceptance_criteria: Receptionist can enter patient demographics including name, DOB, and address
System validates insurance policy number format before saving
Patient record is assigned a unique MRN upon successful registration

title: Appointment Scheduling
description: Patients should be able to schedule appointments with healthcare providers.
acceptance_criteria: Patient can view available time slots for a selected provider
System prevents double-booking the same provider for overlapping time slots
Confirmation notification is sent within 5 minutes of booking

title: Prescription Management
description: Providers must be able to create and manage prescriptions electronically.
acceptance_criteria: Provider can search for medications by name or NDC code
System checks for drug interactions before allowing prescription submission
Patient receives prescription notification via their preferred communication channel
